open_gaps: State the full stability spectrum with its cardinal invariants: for stable T there are cardinals kappa(T) <= |T|^+ and lambda(T) >= 2^|T| such that T is stable in lambda iff lambda = lambda(T) + lambda^{<kappa(T)}, with kappa(T)=infinity for unstable T, and enter it in tab:p03-w03-p03-031-spectrum (statement held: Shelah 1971, section 0, A.1, p. 273); its proof is owed by the 1978 presentation (blocked_source).

Prove the converse spectrum implication for superstability in section 32.2: a stable theory with Deg_m(x=x) finite for every m (equivalently, superstable in the sense of def:p03-stability-spectrum) is lambda-stable for every lambda >= 2^|T|, so that the spectrum entry "lambda-stable for all lambda >= 2^|T|" of tab:p03-w03-p03-031-spectrum is proved in both directions instead of "discussed" (held source: Shelah 1971, Theorems 6.6-6.9 and Corollary 6.10, pp. 354-358).
